Coram : VIKRAMAJIT SEN*, C. NAGAPPAN
B c Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 - s. 24(2) - Deemed lapse of acquisition proceedings under - When can be declared- Held: Factum of award uls. 11 of the 1894 Act must be established and the said award must o have been the commencement of the Act - Once the aforesaid is established, possession is found to not have been taken, or compensation not paid, then the proceedings shall be deemed to have lapsed - In the instant case, land owners submission that either possession E still with them or compensation
Decision Date : 10-03-2015 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5099/2008 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
